shared_elements: rectangular glyph-like blocks with rounded internal motifs
blocks arranged in regular rows/columns forming bands
low-relief carved figural/sign motifs on a flat panel
justification: Both surfaces carry the same distinctive kind of element: square-cornered sign blocks packed with curvilinear internal detail, laid out in a strict grid of rows and columns across the surface, rendered in shallow relief with similar rounded outline conventions. The decisive difference is that B is dominated by a large elaborately costumed standing human figure with a plumed headdress and ornaments, occupying the centre and flanked by the sign columns, whereas A shows only bands of sign blocks with no identifiable figure or figure-to-sign relationship.
